source: Ascension Sidekick leveling-path snapshot (data.js last modified 2026-07-23), Kami Labs embedded build paths (modified 2026-08-29), and the preserved CoA Build Hub community archive. policy: One sourced leveling/community talent path is provided per specialization. These are not ranked as top performers. Outdated Sidekick paths stay withheld unless a separately sourced build passes the current calculator. Sidekick stat and tier recommendations are not imported from its older dataset.
